notes.title: Multi-Tabling Arrives in Zynga Poker!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626567/6d1ee8fa618645b403dcc8f4482d755d909fa9a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The action at the Zynga Poker tables just got bigger! We are excited to introduce Multi-Tabling, a new feature that lets you play at up to three Hold’em cash game tables at the same time.[/p][p]If you are here for nonstop action, this is the way to do it! Multi-Tabling keeps you active at the tables with no waiting around for the next hand. More cards are being dealt, more decisions are on the line, and more chips are up for grabs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How It Works[/b][/p][p]Getting started is simple. Join your favorite Hold’em cash game and when you are ready for more action, tap the prompt to open another table. You can add a second or even a third table with just a click. Move between them easily and stay in the middle of the action from one hand to the next.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why Multi-Table? We're glad you asked:[/b][/p][p]💰 [b]Continuous action[/b]: Never sit idle after folding a hand! [/p][p]🎯 [b]Faster progression[/b]: You'll also earn faster progression on features like Challenge Pass challenges and watch tokens![/p][p]🏆 [b]More opportunities[/b]: By seeing more hands, you'll have more chances to see a monster hand and stack and opponent![/p][p][/p][p][b]Ready to Try It?[/b][/p][p]Multi-Tabling is live today. Open Zynga Poker, take your seat at a Hold’em cash table, and tap to add more when you are ready.[/p][p]More tables. More action. More wins![/p]

notes.title: 🍂 Harvest Royale Poker Album is Live! 🍂
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626567/c5743f4a30bdb980f263c151ff3b561793d5bcd5.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s time to build your collection and celebrate the season with Zynga Poker’s newest Poker Album: [b]Harvest Royale![/b][/p][p align="start"]In this limited-time feature, you can earn [b]Card Packs[/b] simply by playing across Zynga Poker’s many game modes. Rip them open like a true collector and see what surprises you’ll uncover inside![/p][p][/p][h3]Collect and Complete Sets[/h3][list][*][p]There are [b]10 themed sets[/b] in the Harvest Royale Album.[/p][/*][*][p]Each set contains [b]10 unique collectible cards[/b], with seasonal themes like [i]Halloween Haunts, Autumn Nights,[/i] and [i]Cozy Comforts.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Complete a set to unlock a [b]special chip reward.[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Unlock the Ultimate Prize[/h3][p align="start"]For the most dedicated players: completing [b]all 10 sets[/b] will award you with a [b]limited-edition Poker Album collectible[/b]! Adding this unique trophy to your collection is the perfect way to show off that you are a true Zynga Poker grinder![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Whether you’re chasing the spooky thrill of Halloween Haunts, enjoying the calm of Autumn Nights, or stacking chips in true Cozy Comforts fashion, every pack gets you closer to finishing your collection.[/p][p align="start"]The Harvest Royale Poker Album won’t be around forever, so get out there, start collecting, and claim your exclusive rewards today.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/16.0/1f341/32.png"][/img] [b]Play now and make this season your best one yet![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🎶 Poker Music Fest is Live! 🎶
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626567/44793392d244496a10f9f365a92dff2860d5022d.png"][/img][/p][p]The stage is set, the lights are on, and the chips are stacked. It’s time to celebrate in Zynga Poker’s newest limited-time event: Poker Music Fest![/p][p]Join the festival atmosphere and take on limited-edition challenges at the tables. Play your favorite cash games to earn tokens, and when you collect ten, you can exchange them for an exclusive festival-themed watch to add to your collection.[/p][p]Whether you’re chasing big pots at the cash game tables or grinding out your milestones, every hand you play gets you closer to the main stage.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How It Works[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Play non-tournament game tables to start collecting event tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Exchange 10 tokens to unlock a brand-new, exclusive watch[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Keep completing challenges to rack up rewards all festival long[/p][/*][/list][p]Don’t miss your chance to grab the spotlight, secure your rewards, and show off your exclusive new watch at the tables.[/p][p]The music’s loud, the crowd is buzzing, and the chips are waiting. 🎵[/p][p]Hit the tables today and join the Poker Music Fest![/p]

notes.title: Check Out More Ways to Build Your Bankroll in Zynga Poker!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626567/488e0e0c31b3c10abd38aff123d590157033dc2b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Are you looking for a way to move up in stakes and take on the big games? Here's a tip: Zynga Poker has several additional ways to build your bankroll outside of the standard cash game modes! Whether you're chasing the thrill of a grand jackpot, customizing your table presence, or unlocking premium rewards, there's always something extra to play for.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are just a few of the unique game modes and features waiting for you:[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Challenge Pass – Complete, Climb, and Collect[/b][/p][p]Challenge Pass is a season-based progression system packed with poker challenges to complete while you play. Whether it's winning hands or using specific cards, each Challenge moves you closer to bigger chip rewards.[/p][p]Upgrade to the Premium Pass to unlock even more - with up to 10x the prizes for completing your goals.[/p][p][/p][p]🤑 [b]Poker Suits – Collect Cards, Win Big[/b][/p][p]Love collecting? In our rotating Poker Suits events, every card you win with helps fill your collection. For example, if you win a hand with the Ace of Clubs in your hole cards, that card gets added to your collection.[/p][p]Complete a full suit to unlock a grand jackpot of chips — and earn limited-edition card faces to customize the way you play![/p][p][/p][p]⌚ [b]Watch Events – Themed Poker With Collectible Rewards[/b][/p][p]Every two weeks, Zynga Poker introduces a new Watch Event, transforming the look and feel of our cash game tables with themed visuals and unique rewards.[/p][p]As you play, you’ll earn tokens that can be redeemed for an exclusive, event-themed watch. Reach bonus milestones along the way to collect extra chips. From iconic locales like the Las Vegas Strip to fantasy realms like the Queen of Hearts’ castle, these events bring fresh energy and new goals every time you take a seat at the tables![/p][p][/p][p]💼 [b]Play for More Than Just Pots[/b][/p][p]These features give Zynga Poker players more ways to engage, collect, and climb — all while enjoying the same world-class poker experience. When the game launches on Steam, you’ll be able to dive into every mode from day one.[/p]

notes.title: Zynga Poker is Coming Soon to Steam - Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
🎉 Zynga Poker, the world’s most popular free-to-play poker game, is headed to Steam! If you're a fan of nonstop action and huge chip prizes, add us to your Wishlist now and be among the first to join when we go live!

By joining the virtual felt at a Zynga Poker table, you're taking your place at the world's biggest poker party! Take a look at just a few of the modes that Zynga Poker has to offer:

♠ Classic Texas Hold’em Cash Games

Looking for a casual table to unwind or a high-stakes thrill ride? Zynga Poker’s classic Texas Hold’em cash games are always running! Sit down anytime, choose your stakes, and take on the competition. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just getting started, there’s always a game waiting!

🏆 Multi-Table Tournaments Offered Every Day

Zynga Poker offers Multi-Table Tournaments, where you can take on players around the world on a quest to be the last player standing! Play just like the pros and you could turn a small buy-in into a massive payday!
Looking to capture an even bigger prize? Join our weekly Trillionaire Maker Multi-Table Tournaments and compete for trillions of chips in Zynga Poker’s signature high-stakes showdown.

♦ Omaha: Where Four Cards are Better Than Two

Are you ready to get dealt four and watch your bankroll soar? Pot-Limit Omaha delivers! With four hole cards instead of two, Omaha offers bigger hands, wilder swings, and deeper strategy. It’s fast, fun, and fully integrated into Zynga Poker’s lineup of game modes.

🤑 Wishlist Today!

Add Zynga Poker to your Wishlist today and get notified the moment we hit the tables. Whether you're chasing jackpots, climbing the ladder in Leagues, or going for gold in an MTT, there's always a seat for you at Zynga Poker.
